engineChanges.summary: Adds AX-confirmed footer/contentinfo inline text-link fragment preservation across direct and DOM-backed inline generic wrappers, guards block wrappers, and treats native li role=tabpanel as list-participating for list summaries/set positions.
Adds parenthesized set-position wording to tabpanel start/end announcements only when descriptor list context exists.
Adds focused positive and negative coverage for footer inline prose boundaries and native list-item tabpanel positions.

guards: all visible descendant links have unique AX link nodes
AX children flatten only static text, links, and DOM-backed span/small generic wrappers
standalone and/or between adjacent links is skipped
element is a native li in a list/list role
tabpanel position wording requires descriptor positionInSet and setSize
